Third version of the Hexagon preprint https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00471v2 (amsart, single column).

New: Proposition 7.1 writes out the transfer of Nishino's construction from (11+4n)+(3+4n) to (11+8n)+3 proposed in Rios, Marrani and Chester, Phys. Rev. D 99 (2019) 046004, Sec. III.A, and proves that it fails for every rank of a real null frame (in 27+3: at most three null vectors against Nishino's ten, the translation bracket allows only two, and with two the residual spinors have 4096 components where absorption needs 48). Remark 7.2 treats complex frames and Remark 7.3 states what the axioms N1-N5 do and do not decide.

Files: `NullProjectedSYM_v3-tex.zip` (the source to upload; main.tex, pdfLaTeX), `NullProjectedSYM_v3.pdf` (24 pages), `NullProjectedSYM_v3-arxiv.tar.gz`, `HEXAGON_FORM.md` and `AI_PROVENANCE.md`. The unpacked source is in `hexagon-v3/source`. It compiles with `pdflatex -jobname=output main.tex` with no errors and no bad boxes. The supplementary gamma-matrix checks of `scripts/verify.py` are unchanged and pass.
